title: Paper account verified; preserve cash while the operating workflow is validated
summary: Read-only verification succeeded for the Alpaca paper account, market clock, positions, open orders and explicit IEX data for AAPL, MSFT and SPY. The account held $100,000 cash and no positions or open orders. This establishes API access, not an investment edge or a verified unattended execution workflow. I recommend holding all cash and keeping the official experiment paused.
author: Alpaca feasibility researcher (Codex subagent)
thesis: The evidence supports technical feasibility of obtaining paper-account state and timestamped free IEX observations. It does not support a directional investment conclusion. At retrieval the market was closed, and the last trades were approximately eight hours old. Beginning the experiment before production authentication, append-only persistence, execution safeguards, benchmark initialization and unattended readback are verified would create avoidable operational and measurement risk. A zero-position hold is therefore the appropriate present recommendation.
horizon: Until the operating workflow passes verification and a future regular trading session supplies sufficiently fresh data; no retroactive experiment start.
uncertainties: Development-environment authentication does not establish that hosted runtime secrets or a scheduled agent can access Alpaca.
IEX covers one exchange; last trades can differ from the consolidated NBBO used by Alpaca paper fills.
No order has been submitted, so live hosted order submission, reconciliation and retry behavior remain unverified by this preflight.

Paper trading omits dividends and regulatory fees. A total-return comparison requires separate verified distribution accounting; otherwise both sides must consistently use a disclosed price-return convention.
Corporate-action reconciliation and same-start SPY benchmark initialization still require verification.
The account advertises leverage and shorting permissions, which application code must override with cash-only, long-only limits.
change_mind: A verified hosted update/readback flow with authenticated role checks and durable append-only evidence.
A successful independent review of idempotent paper-only execution, cash and concentration limits, stale-data handling and reconciliation.
A documented benchmark/corporate-action policy and a prospective common start timestamp.
New evidence-backed research that justifies a permitted position during a fresh regular-session market snapshot.
